Diego: Post-onsite with GreenCrest — they loved latency, but finance/legal need a per-route breakdown and an errors timeline for SOC review.
Mina: What exact format?
Diego: CSV with columns: account_id, route, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, error_code (nullable). They asked for 120 days. Also asked for a short enablement call for their finance team.
Omar: We can assemble from billing_events. Important: don't include any full transcripts; strip user identifiers. I can run a redacted export and deliver a presigned link.
Hannah: I'll make a short snippet video showing how to import the CSV into Excel and pivot for chargeback reporting.
Diego: Timeline: renewal prep in 2 weeks. They flagged this as high risk if not delivered.
Mina: Action: Omar to run redacted export and share link. Hannah to prep enablement assets. Mina to create product backlog item for "account-level route CSV export + RBAC". Diego to confirm with customer.
CS-Bot: Reminder — GreenCrest renewal call scheduled in 10 business days.
